subject: DJI private DroneID (OcuSync) O4 receiver boundary distinct from standard Remote ID

boundary: Community prior-art documentation, not an independent RF measurement by this project; it does not prove this Mini 5 Pro unit's exact broadcast bearer or content. subject: DJI DroneID distinct from standardized Broadcast Remote ID

The FAQ identifies EN 4709 (EU) and ASTM F3411 (US) as the standard documents and notes that since late 2022 the US/EU began requiring the international-standard Remote ID on WiFi or Bluetooth, which a smartphone app can decode without any DJI-specific receiver or licensed decoder.

statement: A 2026-08-30 community survey (FreeFCC 597157bd, djiparam 1b396b1a, GlassFalcon dadafaa, dji-ocusync-droneid-research 2ca1a92) found no second independent Mini 5 Pro global-RID Boolean implementation beyond the SKYROVER rid_ctrl_enable_0 chain: FreeFCC profiles carry no RID parameter, the djiparam wa150 table has no rid_ctrl_enable_0 row, GlassFalcon exposes only non-RID FlyC commands, and the O4 repository targets the encrypted private DroneID lane.
boundary: A bounded dated survey of public repositories; it does not prove no implementation exists in unindexed or private material, does not establish Mini 5 Pro support for rid_ctrl_enable_0, and does not change the EU C0 flag interpretation.

subject: Independent OpenDroneID synthetic wire codec
statement: An independently written Python codec re-implements the standardized OpenDroneID 25-byte message set (Basic ID, Location/Vector, Auth, Self ID, System, Operator ID) and the 0xF Message Pack container from the public opendroneid-core-c model; its encode reference vectors were produced by compiling the upstream Core C library at commit 12cbebb and match byte-for-byte, and 12 self-contained tests pass.
boundary: Source-only codec for the separate synthetic laboratory source lane; it performs no RF, socket, USB, DUML or aircraft-control action, does not establish a macOS/ESP32/nRF transmit adapter, and does not change Mini 5 Pro Remote ID behavior.

subject: By-index FLYC parameter family independently pinned by o-gs
statement: The public o-gs/dji-firmware-tools tooling independently pins the by-index FLYC parameter family (0xE0 table attributes, 0xE1 get_info, plus the 2017 get_info reply layout status/table/index/type_id/size/def/min/max/NUL-name) and sends parameter requests with sender COMM_DEV_TYPE.PC (0x0a) to FLYCONTROLLER (0x03), matching both the GlassFalcon PC-identity gate and this repository's independently written rid_param_index_protocol.py codec layout.
boundary: Three independent public/self-developed sources agree on the by-index command family and its direct-USB PC (0x0a) sender identity; this is protocol framing and payload-layout corroboration, not a Mini 5 Pro live read/write result or RF evidence.

subject: EuCe C0 RID flag cross-model inventory
statement: Across the public djiparam bundled parameter tables, EU_CE_enable_c0_rid appears only in the wa150 (Mini 5 Pro) and wa151 (Lito X1) tables (both index 1306, u8 0..1 default 0), while EU_CE_Reg_RID_Enable and the EU C0 registration block appear in wa020/wa150/wa151/wa234/wa341; ccc_broadcast_signal_quality appears only in wa020 (Neo 2), and support_china_oid/oid_link_disconnected appear in wa020/wa150/wa151/wa234.

statement: The live Mini 5 Pro (01.00.0600) FLYC table 0 reports CRC 0x5F8B2AE1 and count 1558; the by-hash route positive control g_config.flying_limit.max_height_0 (0x0371238A) returned canonical F7 metadata (type 1, size 2, min 20, max 500, default 120) and F8 value 500, proving the direct-USB FLYC route (0x0A to 0x03) was live this session.
boundary: This only proves the fixed direct-USB FLYC parameter route and positive control were live this session; it does not establish any Remote ID control or RF behavior.

subject: EU_CE_enable_c0_rid absent on live Mini 5 Pro FC
statement: The live Mini 5 Pro (01.00.0600) flight controller does not expose EU_CE_enable_c0_rid: the by-index full enumeration of 915 named parameters contains no such name, index 1306 returns a short status-only reply 0x0E, and by-hash F7 for EU_CE_enable_c0_rid_0 (0xF80992FE) returns a single status byte 0x03; in the same session the positive control max_height_0 and the neighbouring EU C0 rows EU_CE_Reg_RID_Enable_0 (0xA2C325CE) and eu_ce_support_remote_set_level_0 (0xA8E96A09) returned canonical metadata, so the absence is positive-controlled.

statement: The live Mini 5 Pro (01.00.0600) flight controller does not expose rid_ctrl_enable_0: by-hash F7 for 0x3CBD864F returns a single status byte 0x03 and the by-index full enumeration contains no rid_ctrl_enable name; the same-session positive control max_height_0 returned canonical metadata, so the 0x03 is positive-controlled absence on this route.
